definitions.name: _Obertka
definitions.source:
class _Obertka(object):
    def __init__(self, vnutri, kto):
        object.__setattr__(self, "_ua_vnutri", vnutri)
        object.__setattr__(self, "_ua_kto", kto)
        object.__setattr__(self, "_ua_id", _novyy_id())
        object.__setattr__(self, "_ua_t0", time.time())
        object.__setattr__(self, "_ua_busy", "?")
        _dobavit(self._ua_id, kto, "db.connect")
        _zapis("OPEN " + self._ua_id, 0.0, "db.connect | " + kto)

    def __enter__(self):
        c = self._ua_vnutri.__enter__()
        try:
            _privyazat(self._ua_id, c)
            bylo = c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout").fetchone()[0]
            if int(bylo) < 30000:
                c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
                _zapis("BUSY_ISPRAVLEN", 0.0, str(bylo) + " -> 30000 | " + self._ua_kto)
            stalo = c.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout").fetchone()[0]
            object.__setattr__(self, "_ua_busy", stalo)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return c

    def __exit__(self, *a):
        t0 = time.time()
        _zapis("COMMIT_START " + self._ua_id, 0.0, "busy_timeout=" + str(self._ua_busy) + " | " + self._ua_kto)
        try:
            r = self._ua_vnutri.__exit__(*a)
        except Exception as e:
            d = time.time() - t0
            _ubrat(self._ua_id)
            _zapis("COMMIT_FAIL", d, "db.connect | " + self._ua_kto + " | " + repr(e))
            otchet_o_sboe(d, e, self._ua_kto, self._ua_busy)
            raise
        d = time.time() - t0
        _ubrat(self._ua_id)
        _zapis("COMMIT_OK " + self._ua_id, d, self._ua_kto)
        _zapis("CLOSE " + self._ua_id, time.time() - self._ua_t0, self._ua_kto)
        return r

    def __getattr__(self, imya):
        return getattr(object.__getattribute__(self, "_ua_vnutri"), imya)
